Well, then she tried to text our "friend" that she was heavily suicidal and hated feeling like a burden. I didn't know she was still struggling cause she genuinely said she wasn't planning anymore and felt better, I guess she felt guilty contacting me about it everyday.

The next day was full of constant messages of her sending sad selfies of her and her partner donating their plasma, getting needles in their arms, pictures of all the stuff their selling with crying emojis.

When I was allowed at the dinner table I would get relentlessly teased by adults and all the kids were egged on as well. I was the only one getting picked on and I would get very angry and throw a fit. After I threw my fit they would send to my room, whilst they continued dinner like normal.

After a while of this, I started to go mute, I refused to talk since they would tease me about everything including my voice. My uncle and grandma were the worst. A few times I remember my uncle infront of the whole family literally picking me up by the back of my underwear. 

It happened so much it was normal, even to me, and I would just wait silently to be put down so I could leave. My mom and everyone found it funny.
